about.chatbridge.name: Name: %s
tooltip.chatbridge.bridgeEnabled: Enable formatting/filtering of bridge bot messages
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeEnabled: Send bridged messages to your website and receive replies back in-game
tooltip.chatbridge.quoteSystemEnabled: When enabled, messages starting with '>' or '[q]' go to API and are not sent to guild chat
tooltip.chatbridge.quoteApiUrlBackup: Fallback domain used when primary quote API is unavailable
Fallback domain used when primary quote API is unavailable
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeLogJoins: Send an event when you join a server with this mod enabled
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeSendQuote: Include reply target when message contains 'replied to <name>'
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeUrlBackup: Fallback domain used if primary backend fails
Fallback domain used if primary backend fails
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeKey: Must match BRIDGE_KEY on Vercel. Keep it private
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgeChannelId: Use different IDs for different servers/profiles
tooltip.chatbridge.remoteBridgePollMs: How often to check the backend for replies (250..10000)
tooltip.chatbridge.bridgeBotNames: Fallback list of bridge bot usernames (comma/space separated)
tooltip.chatbridge.blockList: If a bridged message contains one of these nicks/words, it will be hidden
tooltip.chatbridge.nickHighlightEnabled: Highlights your nickname in bridged guild messages
tooltip.chatbridge.senderNickColorEnable: Recolors sender nickname without removing [LVL] and other prefixes
tooltip.chatbridge.senderNickLegacyEnabl: If enabled, sender nick will use Minecraft legacy formatting codes (e.g. §4§l)
tooltip.chatbridge.senderNickLegacyCodes: Example: §4§l (dark red + bold). Codes: §0-§f colors, §l bold, §o italic, §n underline, §m strike, §k magic, §r reset
tooltip.chatbridge.senderNickStyleOnlyMi: If enabled, nick styling applies only when sender nick equals your nickname
tooltip.chatbridge.myNickAliases: Extra names to treat as 'mine' (for visual nickname mods). Separate with commas
tooltip.chatbridge.telegramMarker: If message starts with this marker, it is treated as Telegram
tooltip.chatbridge.minecraftMarker: If message starts with this marker, it is treated as Minecraft (e.g. '.')
tooltip.chatbridge.wordHighlightEnabled: Highlights words in message text using rules below
tooltip.chatbridge.wordHighlightRules: Format: word=§codes; scam=§4§l; sale=§e. Separate rules with ';' or new lines
tooltip.chatbridge.wordHighlightOnlyMine: If enabled, word highlighting applies only when sender nick equals your nickname
tooltip.chatbridge.hideBotName: If enabled, bot name may be hidden when formatting
